gaps.lead: I'd rather not go to the meeting.
gaps.explanation: 'Don't feel like doing' = not want to do.

gaps.lead: Most of the children ignored what the teacher had told them.
gaps.sentence: Few of the children ___ what the teacher had told them.

gaps.lead: I have never heard such a ridiculous excuse.
gaps.explanation: Fronted 'never' forces inversion: Never have I heard…

gaps.lead: He began playing chess at the age of six.
gaps.sentence: He ___ at the age of six.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby or sport): took up chess.

gaps.lead: 'I will definitely complete the report by Friday,' I said.
gaps.explanation: commit oneself TO + -ing: committed myself to finishing.

gaps.lead: He spoke slowly because he wanted us to understand him.
gaps.explanation: so that + subject + would/could expresses purpose.
